name: English B2 or higher
definition: Working English at B2 level or higher.
evidence_hint: A stated level (B2, C1, C2, fluent, advanced), a certificate (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge), or documented work or study in English.
exclusions: The language the resume itself is written in is NOT evidence.

name: At least 24 months in customer-facing technical support
definition: Computed by code from the jobs list: relevant months must reach m2_min_months (see Rules).

name: Relevant support experience
definition: Computed by code from the jobs list. Thresholds in Rules: c1_l1_months, c1_l2_months, c1_l3_months.

name: Technical troubleshooting
level_1: Generic words only (for example 'technical issues') with no named tool, protocol or method.
level_2: One named skill (REST API, SQL, logs, webhooks, Postman, browser DevTools) with a description of how it was used.
level_3: Two or more named skills, each with a description of how it was used.
evidence_hint: Named skills with context of use.
exclusions: A skill listed in a skills section without any use described does not earn level 2 or 3.

name: Support tools
level_1: One named ticketing or support tool (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Help Scout, Jira Service Management).
level_3: Three or more named tools, or configuration described (macros, automations, SLA rules).
exclusions: General office software does not count.

name: B2B SaaS context
level_1: Support of a consumer (B2C) product or a non-software product.
level_2: Support of a B2B software or IT product.
level_3: Support of a B2B SaaS product whose customers integrate via API.
evidence_hint: Product type and customer type as written.

name: Knowledge base and documentation
level_1: Documentation duties mentioned without any result.
level_2: Writing knowledge base articles or reply macros is stated.
level_3: Authored volume or effect is stated (number of articles, drop in tickets).
evidence_hint: Verbs such as wrote, authored, maintained plus the object.

name: English level (points beyond M1)
level_1: B2, or work in an English-speaking team is documented.
level_2: C1, advanced, or a certificate at that level (IELTS 7.0-7.5, CAE).
level_3: C2, native, bilingual, or a certificate at that level (IELTS 8.0+, CPE).
exclusions: The language the resume is written in is NOT evidence.

name: Quantified results
level_1: Only volume is stated (tickets per day).
level_2: One result metric with a value (CSAT, first response time, resolution time).
level_3: Two or more result metrics with values.
evidence_hint: Numbers tied to the person's own work.
exclusions: Team-wide or company-wide numbers not tied to the person do not count.
